title: A DAILY RAID ROW ON THE PRE-RAID PAGE
why: His round 3 answer 2.98: a seed of the day raid before launch. One opt-in row on the pre-raid page builds the next career raid on a seed taken from the UTC date, so everyone gets the same raid that day with no server. It keeps its own best haul in new profile fields. No reward, no streak. Normal raids, the demo and the party seed are untouched.
now: A DAILY RAID row sits under the surface and weather rows on the pre-raid page. Switch it on and the next ascent is today raid, the same for everyone. Its best haul shows on the row.
